title: PROC SQL GROUP BY, AVG and scale-9 checkpoint

sources.P1: proc sql; create table mart.sky_summary as select sector, count(*) as n, count(distinct reading) as uniq, sum(reading) as total_reading, avg(reading) as mean_reading, count(reading) as present from source.readings group by sector having count(*)>0; quit;

source: proc sql; create table mart.sky_summary as select sector, count(*) as n, count(distinct reading) as uniq, sum(reading) as total_reading, avg(reading) as mean_reading, count(reading) as present from source.readings group by sector having count(*)>0; quit;
arithmetic_contract: Exact decimal after transport; round final storage to scale 9 half away from zero, then QA scale 3; average of all missing is NULL.

sources.P2: proc sql; create table mart.dispatch_board as select p.id,p.weight,p.zone,z.label from work.ready_parcels p left join source.zones z on p.zone=z.zone; quit;
